# Tailbone Treatment Clinic

> Specialist, non-surgical treatment for tailbone (coccyx) pain, also called coccydynia or coccygodynia, led by Dr Rajveer Singh (BPT, Fellowship in Orthopaedic Rehabilitation, Apollo Hospital Chennai). Clinic in Vasant Kunj, New Delhi, India, plus online video consultations worldwide. Lucknow clinic opening soon. The Bengaluru clinic has closed.

Key facts:
- Conditions treated: coccydynia (tailbone pain), subluxed or dislocated coccyx, tailbone pain after a fall or injury, after pregnancy or childbirth, pain when sitting, chronic tailbone discomfort.
- Approach: assessment and diagnosis, hands-on Internal Manipulation of the coccyx and surrounding muscles, posture and seating advice, exercises and follow-up. Surgery is rarely needed.
- Address: 150A/09, Shanti Apartment, Kishangarh, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi 110070, India.
- Hours (by appointment): Monday–Friday 10:00–17:00, Saturday 10:00–15:00, Sunday 08:00–15:00 (IST).
- Fees: consultation ₹800 (in clinic or online); follow-up within 7 days ₹500.
- Book: https://tailbone.netlify.app/book · WhatsApp or phone +91 98866 88323 · contact@tailbonetreatment.com
- Medical information on this site is general and not a substitute for an examination.

## Articles

- [Tailbone pain explained in pictures: from the first twinge to the right treatment](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-pain-explained-in-pictures.html): A visual guide to coccydynia. Why sitting loads the tailbone, how it gets injured, how to tell it from other pain, what sitting and standing X-rays show, and how treatment is stepped up.
- [Amusement and water park rides: protect your tailbone (and your child's)](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/amusement-park-rides-and-tailbone-injury.html): Sudden drops and jolts on dry and water rides can push the coccyx out of place, in teenagers as well as adults. Dr Rajveer Singh's tips to ride safely, and what to do if it hurts afterwards.
- [Why "bone setting" for tailbone pain can be dangerous](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-bone-setting-risks.html): Pressing or massaging the tailbone from outside, without knowing which way it has shifted, can push an inward-displaced coccyx deeper into the pelvis. Dr Rajveer Singh explains the risk.
- [Kegel exercises and tailbone pain: when squeezing makes it worse](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/kegel-exercises-and-tailbone-pain.html): Kegels and "butt-squeezing" are often suggested for pelvic pain. Dr Rajveer Singh explains why they can pull an inward-shifted or fractured coccyx further out of place, and what to do instead.
- [Tailbone subluxation: why the direction of the shift decides the treatment](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-subluxation-inward-or-outward.html): A displaced coccyx can be pushed inward into the pelvis or outward. Dr Rajveer Singh explains why the direction must be known first, how treatment differs, and how one patient recovered.
- [Why women get tailbone pain five times more often than men](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/why-women-get-tailbone-pain.html): Women are about five times more likely than men to develop coccydynia. Pelvis shape, childbirth and pregnancy hormones all play a part. Here is what the research shows.
- [Two-wheelers, potholes and tailbone pain: what the research shows](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/two-wheeler-riding-and-tailbone-pain.html): A 2025 study found tailbone pain in a third of regular motorbike riders, and vibration was the strongest risk factor. What that means for daily commuters in Delhi, and how to protect your coccyx.
- [When it isn't the coccyx: conditions that can mimic tailbone pain](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-pain-mimics.html): Pilonidal cysts, nerve pain, cysts on the sacral nerves, stress fractures and, rarely, tumours can all feel like tailbone pain. How they differ, and why a careful examination comes first.
